parameters.name: Description
parameters.description: The description of the prohibited software tag. The description can contain letters, digits, Chinese characters, spaces, periods (.), underscores (_), and hyphens (-), and cannot exceed 128 characters in length.

parameters.name: Name
parameters.description: The name of the prohibited software tag. The name must be 1 to 128 characters in length and can contain letters, digits, Chinese characters, periods (.), underscores (_), and hyphens (-). Spaces are not supported.

parameters.name: TagId
parameters.description:
The ID of the custom prohibited software tag. Only custom tags under the current Alibaba Cloud account can be modified. Built-in system tags cannot be modified. You can obtain the value from the following operations:
- [ListProhibitedTags](~~ListProhibitedTags~~): Lists prohibited software tags.
- [CreateProhibitedTag](~~CreateProhibitedTag~~): Creates a custom prohibited software tag.
